info.title: Content API
info.description: Typed content and search API for the web front end. CMS and search engine are swappable adapters.

post.description: Called by the CMS on publish/unpublish/delete/move with `{ "id": "..." }` (or an array of those, as sent for move and moved-to-recycle-bin). Each item is re-read from the content source and upserted if published, otherwise removed; when its path changed or it disappeared, the documents indexed below its old path are re-read as well. Afterwards every page in the web cache is invalidated (`WebCache:PurgeUrl`), so the site shows the change at once; purging after the index update keeps list pages from being cached with stale results. Requires the `X-Webhook-Secret` header.

get.summary: Get the status of the API's dependencies
get.description: Overall and per-component status (`healthy`, `degraded` or `unhealthy`) for the status page. Always 200: the status is in the body. The dependencies are checked at most every 10 seconds; in between the last report is returned. Probes should use `/health`.

get.summary: Get a page by its URL path
get.description: Returns the published page at `path` (e.g. `/articles`; `/` is the home page).
Root pages (normally the home page) with their descendants as children, in CMS sort order. Articles are not included; list them with `/api/articles`.
Ordered by publish date, descending. `tag` keeps only articles with that tag (case-insensitive).
Every tag used by a published article and how many articles carry it, most used first.

Searches pages and articles. `contentType`, `tag` and `year` (publish year) narrow the results; `facets` counts the values of each, ignoring that facet's own filter. An empty `q` lists everything, newest first. `highlight` is HTML-escaped text with matches wrapped in `<mark>`.

post.summary: Rebuild the search index from the content source
post.description: Builds a fresh index and swaps it in atomically; search keeps serving the previous contents until the rebuild has succeeded, then purges the web cache. Requires the `X-Reindex-Secret` header (`Search:ReindexSecret`).

get.description: Full-text search over title, brand, category, SKU and specs. `category`, `brand`, `minRating` (whole stars) and `inStock` narrow the results; `facets` counts each, ignoring that facet's own filter. `sort`: relevance (default; popular when `q` is empty), popular, price-asc, price-desc, rating, newest. Stock and sales come from the index (refreshed every few minutes and after each order); the product page has live values.
Live from the commerce backend. An outdated slug still finds the product (it ends in the SKU); redirect when `slug` differs from the requested one.

post.description: Returns the cart and its token. Every other cart call needs the token in `X-Cart-Token`; a missing or wrong token answers 404, like an unknown cart.

post.summary: Add a product to the cart
post.description: Adds `quantity` (1–99) of the product with `sku`, merging with an existing line. 409 `out_of_stock` (with `available`) when the cart would hold more than is in stock.

patch.summary: Change the quantity of a cart line

post.summary: Pay with the fake card processor and place the order
post.description: Demo payment, no money moves. Card 4242 4242 4242 4242 (or any other valid number) is approved; 4000 0000 0000 0002 is declined (`card_declined`), 4000 0000 0000 9995 `insufficient_funds`, 4000 0000 0000 0069 `expired_card` (402). 400 `invalid_checkout` lists field errors in `fields`; 409 for an empty cart, missing stock or a cart that was already checked out.
